# glinet Provider

Interact with GL.iNet routers that run v4 firmware.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "glinet" {
  host     = "http://192.168.8.1"
  username = "root"
  password = "password"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) URI for GL.iNet API. May also be provided via GLINET_HOST environment variable. Defaults to `http://192.168.8.1`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for GL.iNet API. May also be provided via GLINET_PASSWORD environment variable.
- `username` (String) Username for GL.iNet API. May also be provided via GLINET_USERNAME environment variable. Defaults to `root`.
